notes: 0.3.22: Benchmark Pricing is now a to-do list: To review and Accepted with a live count, a typed Current price counts as accepted, and the search box takes an NFC chip. Every row shows what you paid and whether you are green or red, with a Losing filter, hidden in streamer mode. The card panel opens from the pencil, lists every listing as its own row, shows printing and language at the top, and never edits the Benchmark by hand. Accept with a typed price keeps your number. A card missing its printing or language asks for it and reprices. Pick the card writes the whole identity and the Skyridge reverse holos are back in the list. Sealed items get a Sealed condition and price from eBay only, with the eBay search as their link. A Chip line in the Tags area scans an NFC chip onto a card and walks a stack with Next card. Card pictures change through the catalog, owner only; drag a picture in from a browser. Inventory typing is fast again. A sales read that did not load is treated as a failure, never as no sales. The Benchmark now lands between the newest sale and the cheapest listing, identical copies share one price, and one engine writes it. Backups keep the last twelve and one per day for two weeks, the automatic backup refuses to bury a good file, restore lets you pick the file, and every restore checks its own counts. The PkmnPrices key lives in the cloud, never in the app.
